title: High pitched whine, ineffective on rugs, canister doesn't reattach easily
text:
High pitched whine, ineffective on rugs, canister doesn't reattach easily. Ok...This machine is not the same as my other Dirt Devil stick vac. This one is very light and easy enough to physically use. The comparison ends there because my three year old Dirt Devil is so much better.

My first issue the high pitched, very loud whine the motor makes as soon as it turns on. It does this constantly. Secondly, the power and roller brush are both weak. Trying to use this on a low pile area rug is essentially useless. It's better on tile and hardwood flooring, but barely. Third problem is the canister. It comes off correctly, but doesn't reattach easily - mine clicks and looks attached, but it falls out when I restart the vacuum. This is seriously obnoxious. The one good thing is the plastic pet hair attachment - it does pull cat hair out of fabric surprisingly well. However, in the end, this vacuum really doesn't work well for me.
